LanguageData.VTE_HeatInclined.degreeDatas.0.label: heat-adapted
LanguageData.VTE_HeatInclined.degreeDatas.0.descripti: {PAWN_nameDef} is accustomed to dry heat and sun-baked settlements. {PAWN_pronoun} tolerates hot work and warm nights better than most.
LanguageData.VTE_ColdInclined.degreeDatas.0.label: cold-adapted
LanguageData.VTE_ColdInclined.degreeDatas.0.descripti: {PAWN_nameDef} is accustomed to bitter wind, unheated ruins and long winters. {PAWN_pronoun} tolerates cold work and frigid nights better than most.
LanguageData.VTE_AnimalHater.degreeDatas.0.label: animal-averse
LanguageData.VTE_AnimalHater.degreeDatas.0.descriptio: {PAWN_nameDef} regards animals as filthy, dangerous competitors for scarce food. {PAWN_pronoun} dislikes bonds and nuzzling, and feels relief when unwanted animals are sold or killed.
LanguageData.VTE_Technophobe.degreeDatas.0.label: technophobe
LanguageData.VTE_Technophobe.degreeDatas.0.descriptio: Whether from trauma or hard-earned suspicion, {PAWN_nameDef} distrusts automated machinery and advanced old-world systems. During a breakdown {PAWN_pronoun} may lash out at technology, and seeing a hostile robot destroyed brings grim satisfaction.
LanguageData.VTE_Snob.degreeDatas.0.label: old-world snob
LanguageData.VTE_Snob.degreeDatas.0.description: {PAWN_nameDef} believes {PAWN_pronoun} belongs among the pre-War elite, and loves nothing more than critiquing taste, status and old-world luxury.
LanguageData.VTE_Insatiable.degreeDatas.0.label: libidinous
LanguageData.VTE_Insatiable.degreeDatas.0.description: No amount of intimacy is ever enough for {PAWN_nameDef}. {PAWN_pronoun} seeks romance often, tires of partners quickly and is far more likely than most to begin or end a relationship.
LanguageData.VTE_Prude.degreeDatas.0.label: puritanical
LanguageData.VTE_Prude.degreeDatas.0.description: {PAWN_nameDef} follows a strict personal code concerning intimacy. {PAWN_pronoun} will sleep only with a spouse, will never initiate divorce and is especially uncomfortable with nudity.
LanguageData.VTE_CouchPotato.degreeDatas.0.label: screen addict
LanguageData.VTE_CouchPotato.degreeDatas.0.descriptio: An armchair and a working screen are all {PAWN_nameDef} needs to be happy. {PAWN_pronoun} can watch old broadcasts and battered holotapes for hours, and remains pleased long after the program ends.
LanguageData.VTE_ChildOfSea.degreeDatas.0.label: coastborn
LanguageData.VTE_ChildOfSea.degreeDatas.0.description: Open water feels like home to {PAWN_nameDef}. {PAWN_pronoun} is happier near an ocean or deep river and even enjoys being soaked by rain or surf.
LanguageData.VTE_ChildOfMountain.degreeDatas.0.label: mountain-bred
LanguageData.VTE_ChildOfMountain.degreeDatas.0.descri: Stone ridges and sheltered valleys feel like home to {PAWN_nameDef}. {PAWN_pronoun} is happier near great mountains and finds enclosed darkness comforting.
LanguageData.VTE_MadSurgeon.degreeDatas.0.label: organ obsessive
LanguageData.VTE_MadSurgeon.degreeDatas.0.description: {PAWN_nameDef} treats organ harvesting as both experiment and compulsion. Successful extractions bring satisfaction, but going too long without a new subject feeds mounting unrest.
LanguageData.VTE_DrunkenMaster.degreeDatas.0.label: drunken brawler
LanguageData.VTE_DrunkenMaster.degreeDatas.0.descript: {PAWN_nameDef} fights best after several drinks. The more intoxicated {PAWN_pronoun} becomes, the more dangerous {PAWN_possessive} melee attacks become.
LanguageData.VTE_Insomniac.degreeDatas.0.label: insomniac
LanguageData.VTE_Insomniac.degreeDatas.0.description: {PAWN_nameDef} sleeps rarely and never deeply. Long waking stretches leave {PAWN_objective} slower and less productive, even though {PAWN_possessive} need for rest rises far more slowly than normal.
LanguageData.VTE_WorldWeary.degreeDatas.0.label: jaded
LanguageData.VTE_WorldWeary.degreeDatas.0.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has seen too much to remain easily impressed. Diversions lose their appeal quickly, and {PAWN_pronoun} rarely develops strong positive or negative feelings about other people.
LanguageData.VTE_RefinedPalate.degreeDatas.0.label: gourmet
LanguageData.VTE_RefinedPalate.degreeDatas.0.descript: Only exceptional meals satisfy {PAWN_nameDef}. Merely fine food earns no enthusiasm, while truly lavish cooking brings far greater pleasure than it does to most.
LanguageData.VTE_ThickSkinned.degreeDatas.0.label: rapid clotting
LanguageData.VTE_ThickSkinned.degreeDatas.0.descripti: {PAWN_nameDef}'s blood coagulates unusually quickly. Open wounds bleed at roughly half the normal rate.
LanguageData.VTE_ThinSkinned.degreeDatas.0.label: hemophilia
LanguageData.VTE_ThinSkinned.degreeDatas.0.descriptio: {PAWN_nameDef}'s blood does not clot properly. Open wounds bleed far more heavily than normal.
LanguageData.VTE_Schizoid.degreeDatas.0.label: bottled-up
LanguageData.VTE_Schizoid.degreeDatas.0.description: {PAWN_nameDef} suppresses distress until only the most severe breaking point can release it. Lesser breakdowns never come; when {PAWN_possessive} composure finally fails, it fails catastrophically.
